commonizerTools.originLimitation: The model records the exact JAR paths in harmony-build/.local/gradle-user-home/caches/modules-2/files-2.1. POMs were read from the same Gradle files-2.1 cache. The model/cache does not retain the upstream repository origin for each file; do not label these as Maven Central or maven-develop provenance.

compilerTools.originLimitation: Exact source cache files and SHA/bytes are recorded; the Gradle files-2.1 cache and diagnostic models do not preserve upstream repository identity.

versionSelectionAndExclusions.compilerBuildToolsImplRequest: kotlinBuildToolsApiClasspath requestedDependencies records required=.08 and strict=.08 for kotlin-build-tools-impl; corresponding edge display contains {strictly .08}. KGP plugin code strictly pins impl to compilerVersion/pluginVersion.
versionSelectionAndExclusions.compilerClasspathModelConstraintLimit: R3 records requested coordinates and edge.constraint, not requested versionConstraint; the BTA graph supplies the exact strict impl constraint. No selected edge is a Gradle constraint edge.
versionSelectionAndExclusions.stdlibConflict: Compiler and BTA graphs select kotlin-stdlib .08 with a CONFLICT_RESOLUTION reason between .08 and 2.2.21. kotlin-daemon-client POM requests 2.2.21; selected version remains .08.
wildcardExclusions: kotlin-compiler-embeddable POM declares kotlin-reflect:1.6.10 and kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm:1.8.0 dependencies with *:* exclusions; the two modules themselves remain selected. Their excluded transitive children are not selected.
kotlin-reflect POM declares kotlin-stdlib:1.6.10, but that edge is absent under the wildcard exclusion.

kotlinx-coroutines-core-jvm POM imports kotlinx-coroutines-bom:1.8.0 and declares annotations:23.0.0 and kotlin-stdlib:1.9.21; these child edges are excluded in the selected compiler/commonizer graphs. The BOM POM is still metadata-only input.
